item.title: Cephx Key Migration Procedure and Ceph 19.2 Squid Going EOL Soon
item.author: invalid@example.com (t.lamprecht)
item.dc:creator: t.lamprecht
item.content:encoded:
Recent security findings and fixes in Ceph make it necessary to upgrade ceph and migrate authentication keys from the aes to the aes256k cipher. This is to address weaknesses in the old Cephx authentication method, especially if your Ceph service networks are not isolated. Hello, the guide overall was helpful, but ran into the same issue as another user where I had to increase the timeout in the helper script to be able to update the CephFS keys:

Code: 
perl -0pi -e 's/(PVE::Tools::run_command\(\s*\[\x27umount\x27,\s*\$path\],\s*timeout\s*=>\s*)20/$1 65/' \
/usr/share/pve-manager/migrations/pve-cephx-rotate-service-keys

After that the storage keys and admin key was successful:

Code: 
root@pve01:/etc/pve/priv/ceph#...
